- Tue Mar 2: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15

I've attached a short agenda and a sample network diagram. If those times don't work, please send availability and we'll coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Priya — thanks for the list. I'll cover SCIM, SAML, and customer-managed keys in the pre-read and during the IAM section. Quick notes for the agenda:

- SCIM: supported; we'll present SCIM provisioning best practices and common gotchas (group sync, rate limits).
- SAML: SSO supported with configurable assertion mappings; audit logs available via the Console and can be exported to the customer's SIEM.
- KMS: we support both provider-managed and customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS); bring-your-own-key flows supported — I'll include rotation and key policy considerations.

I'm uploading a 3-slide pre-read and the updated network diagram (stub) to the Drive link Marissa shared.

Logan — can you be available Wed Mar 3 09:00 PST as a backup in case we need to move?
